headline: A 2022 law renames the Honeoye Falls, New York, post office at 39 West Main Street in honor of Army Chief Warrant Officer Christian J. Koch.
what_it_does: The law officially designates the U.S. Postal Service facility at 39 West Main Street in Honeoye Falls, New York, as the CW4 Christian J. Koch Memorial Post Office. It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 11, 2022, and the designation took effect on that date.
